def R_star (U₀ U₁ : InterleavedWord A (Fin m) ι) : Finset F :=
  Finset.filter (fun r : F =>

/-- The set D = Δ^{2m}(U, V), columns where U₀≠V₀ or U₁≠V₁. -/
def disagreementSet (U₀ U₁ V₀ V₁ : InterleavedWord A (κ := κ) (ι := ι)) : Finset ι :=

    Uᵣ j = Vᵣ j)
